scope: All 48 previously unaudited core-basics and SP/XT connector entries. Source-specific decisions are independent of KiCad carrier marks. Generic axial examples are explicitly representative, like the existing generic resistor/LED examples.

reviewedSourceArtifacts.review: Page 1 product drawing and same-side photograph: 7.11 mm maximum body length, 2.79 mm maximum diameter, 0.51 mm round leads, 25.40 mm minimum per side.

entries.name: Axial Inductor
entries.reason: Representative Bourns 78F-style axial choke, not identification of the unspecified generic inductor. The fixed 7.11 × 2.79 mm envelope uses the manufacturer maximum body dimensions and 0.51 mm round leads. Form only the leads to the initial 10.16 mm span; at least 25.4 mm of untrimmed lead is supplied on either side. The 20 mm projected reach leaves insertion allowance. Bands are representative and do not specify inductance. Default artwork and native geometry are unchanged.

evidence.label: Bourns 78F axial RF choke mechanical example, product dimensions

source.label: Bourns 78F axial RF choke mechanical example, product dimensions

entries.name: Ferrite Bead
entries.reason: Representative straight-leaded Murata BL01RN1A1D2B mechanical example; it does not identify every generic ferrite bead. The fixed 5.3 × 3.75 mm envelope uses maximum source dimensions, with 0.65 mm round leads. Initial 10.16 mm tip spacing leaves more than the source 1.5 mm coating extension beyond either body exit before bending downward. Limit projected reach to 15 mm from each exit; the source supplies at least 20 mm of straight lead per side. Default artwork and native geometry are unchanged.

evidence.label: Murata BL01RN1A1D2B manufacturer reference specification JENF243G-0003E-01, page 3 (distributor-hosted original)

source.label: Murata BL01RN1A1D2B manufacturer reference specification JENF243G-0003E-01, page 3 (distributor-hosted original)

entries.name: NPN Transistor
entries.reason: The generic NPN symbol does not identify a transistor ordering code or a unique B/C/E lead order. Its TO-92 reference carrier is not evidence for one physical variant. Choose a source-identified named transistor; do not reinterpret saved electrical IDs as a guessed package order.

entries.name: N-Channel MOSFET
entries.reason: The generic MOSFET does not identify an ordering code or a unique G/D/S TO-92 lead sequence. Preserve the saved logical terminals and native representative carrier; a matching source-identified device is required before defining physical lead roots.

entries.name: Tactile Push Button
entries.reason: The existing generic switch has only two electrical contact IDs while its approximate 6×6 mm native drawing represents a four-tail tactile package. Automatic insertion cannot silently invent the missing two physical tails. Use the separately reviewed four-ID Omron B3F-1000, or add an explicit saved-project migration for a different exact variant.

entries.name: 2-pin Screw Terminal
entries.reason: A 5.08 mm nominal pitch is a possible breadboard lattice, but this unspecified two-position screw terminal has no matching part number, source post cross-section, available insertion length or component-side/solder-side mechanical map. A generic carrier drill is not proof that the actual terminal pins fit a solderless socket.

entries.name: 3-pin Screw Terminal
entries.reason: The unspecified three-position terminal has a nominal 5.08 mm reference carrier, not a source-identified installed post pattern. Exact post width/thickness, length and complete housing orientation remain unresolved. It is a potential 5.08 mm candidate rather than categorically incompatible.

entries.name: JST PH 2-pin
entries.reason: The exact JST B2B-PH-K-S vertical wire-to-board header uses 2.0 mm pitch. The manufacturer PH drawing confirms its PCB tails and mating socket; neither can be rescaled to 2.54 mm. The existing polarity-neutral stable contacts remain wireable.

evidence.label: Exact manufacturer part/package reference

entries.name: DC Power Source
entries.reason: This is a generic external DC source or battery connection, not a defined cell holder with rigid insertion posts. The native pads are explicitly a host-board cable termination. Preserve positive/negative wire endpoints without presenting the source body as an insertable package.

entries.name: WEIPU SP1310/P2 Cable Plug
entries.reason: WEIPU SP1310/P2 Cable Plug is the 2-contact straight cable plug with solder wire terminations. The manufacturer assembly instruction explicitly requires soldered insulated wires and a cable backshell. Its circular mating contacts are not downward breadboard posts. The linear 5.08/7.62 mm native carrier is an off-board wire reference, not this connector's pin geometry.

entries.name: AMASS XT60PB-F Female
entries.reason: AMASS XT60PB-F Female is an actual vertical PCB power connector, distinguished from the cable variants. The manufacturer catalog specifies the dedicated PCB assembly and 3.0 mm weld legs. The retained source-coordinate contact reference records 7.20 mm terminal separation and 4.60 mm finished PCB holes, rather than 0.1-inch square posts. That pattern is not a multiple of 2.54 mm; the 7.62 mm wire carriers of other XT parts must not be substituted. No direct solderless insertion is enabled.

evidence.label: Manufacturer 2026 catalog, printed page 17: XT60PB-M/F dedicated PCB version
